why: Cartoon Sam at a desk with a laptop and a full notepad, smiling, a bright skill icon glowing on the desk.
Same desk, a week on: the notepad lies open but untouched, Sam frowns at a blank screen with a blinking cursor, the skill icon dull.
Presenter beside a small calendar where short ten-minute blocks appear on separate days, ahead of a task marker.
A sticky week calendar on Sam's desk; the training notes pinned on it blur a little from day to day.
The skill icon on Sam's desk starts bright and visibly dims, a faint fade line tracing its brightness against the days.
The fade line drops steeply on the first days then flattens, labels sitting on the steep part and the flat part of the curve; the icon dims to match.
The curve held on screen with its axes left unmarked, no numbers on either axis, one small tag saying the rate varies.
Sam leaning back, hands off the keyboard, while the icon sits dim at the bottom of the curve; a coin hovers over the desk.
Two timelines stacked, same total effort drawn as the same amount of colour: one thick block on day one, and several thin slices on later days.
On the one-block timeline the skill line shoots up after the block and stays high for the next day.
The one-block line slides down after its peak with no further lifts, the slope steeper than the other timeline.
On the second timeline the skill line gets a small lift at each thin slice and stays above the one-block line.
The big block on the left labelled as feeling serious, next to the spread slices on the right labelled with the word usually.
The name appears over the spread timeline, the two lines still visible, the spread one on top.
The first fading curve returns, its steep early stretch highlighted, a small visit marker placed in that stretch.
Sam watches the training recording on a screen, nodding, a thought bubble reading I know this.
Two labelled jars side by side next to Sam: one filled with a familiar glow, one empty labelled knowing.
Sam shuts the recording, the software opens on an empty form, Sam's hands hover over the keys with nothing to type.
The name appears next to Sam's closed notes and open blank software, with the notes shown shut.
Sam compares screen and recording; a gap list on the notepad fills in one missed step per phrase.
Two arrows on the notepad: try first, then check, in that order, with the gap list beside them.
Sam looks glum at a gap list with several entries; a speech bubble says this is not working, then a green zone band labelled somewhat hard appears around Sam's effort level.
An easy-looking smooth path beside a slightly uphill path, with the name over the uphill one.
The uphill path with a sheer cliff drawn beyond it, crossed out, next to the manageable slope with a checkpoint flag.
Recap strip on the notepad: re-watch crossed out, try then check ticked, a few misses marked as normal.
Sam at the desk with a new approval tool on screen, three blank plan cards waiting on the side.
Three plan cards slide in one per option, each with a small picture: a screen, a notepad with a calendar, a single big block.
Card B lights up with a tick, card A dims with a tag familiar, not known; the other card fades away.
The blank form from the hook returns on Sam's screen, three empty step cards lined up beside it.
Card one fills in; the notes and recording shut, and Sam fills the form from memory, a few steps appearing.
Card two fills in; the gap list shows the missed steps, each one a line on the notepad.
Card three fills in; a small calendar shows the try marked on a later day, with empty days between.
On the calendar, the later-day marker is attached to a real task card in Sam's work week.
The gap list on the notepad shrinks across two later days, lines crossing off until only one remains.
Three step cards stacked side by side with the quiz card B beside them, matching their contents.
Split screen: Sam on the left, a blank week calendar on the right for the viewer.
On the blank calendar one day gets a task marker that uses the skill.
A short try marker appears on the task day, a notes icon stays closed beside it, then a check mark follows.
Two calendar entries side by side: one an eye icon labelled re-read, the other a pencil over closed notes labelled retrieval.
The hook's desk scene returns with the same angle: Sam types through the task, pauses at one step, checks the notepad, continues; the skill icon is bright.
Presenter beside four words appearing in turn, with Sam's bright icon on the desk behind.
